name: Sacramento

neighborhoods.name: Midtown
neighborhoods.homes: Victorian houses split into apartments and small apartment buildings

housing: Sacramento's central grid has Victorians and bungalows split into apartments; Natomas and the suburbs add apartment complexes and newer houses.

localRules.text: Sacramento's Tenant Protection Program limits rent increases and evictions for most multifamily rentals, and landlords must register those units with the city each year.
The City of Sacramento's Rental Housing Inspection Program charges a per-unit fee and inspects rentals to address substandard conditions.

climate: Hot, dry summers make air conditioning important; test it, check window seals, and photograph yards and gutters, since winter storms can bring heavy rain.
fact: Sacramento has both a city and a county rental inspection program, so check which one applies to your address.
